senses.zh: 叶子；（书籍等的）一张；扇页
senses.en: one of the flat green parts of a plant that are joined to its stem or branches
To move downward, lose balance, or decrease.
An act of falling or a decrease in amount.
The season between summer and winter, especially in American English.

ex.en: Golden leaves fall onto the path outside our house.
ex.zh: 金黄的叶子落在我们屋外的小路上。

ex.en: Energy consumption may fall if governments encourage households to install better insulation and efficient heating systems.
ex.zh: 如果政府鼓励家庭改善隔热条件并安装高效供暖系统，能源消耗可能会下降。

tip: 过去式fell，过去分词fallen；秋天英式常用autumn。

senses.en: a coloured substance spread on surfaces for protection or decoration
to cover a surface with paint
to create a picture using paint

ex.en: There is blue paint all over your hands.
ex.zh: 你的双手沾满了蓝色颜料。

ex.en: Schools should allow children to paint regularly, as creative activities can support emotional development and self-expression.
ex.zh: 学校应让孩子经常绘画，因为创意活动有助于情感发展和自我表达。

col: a coat of paint｜一层油漆
tip: paint多指用颜料画；draw多指用铅笔等画线条。

senses.en: the first month of the year

ex.en: Our swimming lessons begin in January this year.
ex.zh: 我们今年的游泳课从一月开始。

ex.en: Many people set health goals in January, but maintaining new habits requires consistent support.
ex.zh: 许多人在一月设定健康目标，但保持新习惯需要持续的支持。

tip: 月份首字母大写；在一月用in January。

senses.en: The second month of the year.

ex.en: My sister starts her new job in February.
ex.zh: 我姐姐二月份开始新工作。

ex.en: The community centre will introduce additional evening classes in February to meet growing demand.
ex.zh: 社区中心将在二月份增设夜间课程，以满足不断增长的需求。

tip: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

senses.en: Walk with firm, regular steps, often in a group.
An organised walk by a group, often to protest.
Music with a strong regular rhythm suitable for marching.

ex.en: The band marched through the square in bright uniforms.
ex.zh: 乐队身穿鲜艳的制服，齐步走过广场。

ex.en: Residents organised a peaceful march to demand safer roads and better public transport in their neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 居民组织了一场和平游行，要求改善社区道路安全和公共交通。

col: march through the streets｜列队穿过街道
tip: 小写march指行进；大写March指三月。

senses.en: The fourth month of the year.

ex.en: We are moving into our new flat in April.
ex.zh: 我们将在四月搬进新公寓。

ex.en: The community garden will open in April, giving local residents more opportunities to grow their own vegetables.
ex.zh: 社区菜园将于四月开放，让当地居民有更多机会自己种菜。

tip: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

senses.zh: 可以，能够；可能，也许；祝，愿；会，能

senses.en: The sixth month of the year, between May and July.

ex.en: My sister is getting married in June this year.
ex.zh: 我姐姐今年六月要结婚了。

ex.en: The community centre will open in June, providing local residents with affordable exercise classes.
ex.zh: 社区中心将于六月开放，为当地居民提供价格实惠的健身课程。

col: by the end of June｜到六月底为止
tip: 月份首字母大写；在六月用in June。

senses.en: The seventh month of the year, following June

ex.en: We usually visit our cousins for a week in July.
ex.zh: 我们通常在七月去表亲家住一周。

ex.en: In many northern countries, tourism peaks in July, creating seasonal jobs but increasing pressure on local services.
ex.zh: 在许多北方国家，旅游业在七月达到高峰，创造了季节性岗位，却也增加了当地公共服务的压力。

col: by the end of July｜到七月底之前
tip: 月份首字母大写；表示在七月用in July。

senses.en: the eighth month of the year

ex.en: We usually visit our grandparents by the sea in August.
ex.zh: 我们通常八月去看望住在海边的祖父母。

ex.en: Tourist destinations often experience increased demand in August, putting pressure on local transport and accommodation.
ex.zh: 旅游目的地的需求往往在八月增加，给当地交通和住宿带来压力。

tip: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

senses.en: The month after August and before October.

ex.en: Our evening photography course starts in September this year.
ex.zh: 我们今年的摄影夜课九月开课。

ex.en: In many countries, the academic year begins in September, creating seasonal demand for student accommodation near universities.
ex.zh: 许多国家的学年在九月开始，使大学附近的学生住宿出现季节性需求。

tip: 月份首字母大写；用 in September，但 next September 前不加 in。

senses.en: The tenth month of the year, between September and November.

ex.en: Our local swimming pool will open again in October.
ex.zh: 我们当地的游泳池将在十月重新开放。

ex.en: The university begins its annual community research programme in October, giving students opportunities to investigate local environmental issues.
ex.zh: 这所大学每年十月启动社区研究项目，让学生有机会调查当地环境问题。

tip: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

senses.en: The eleventh month of the year.

ex.en: We are moving into our new flat in November.
ex.zh: 我们将在十一月搬进新公寓。

ex.en: The university plans to launch its new scholarship programme in November, allowing more international students to apply.
ex.zh: 该大学计划在十一月推出新的奖学金项目，让更多国际学生能够申请。

tip: 月份首字母大写；月份前用in，具体日期前用on。

senses.en: the final month of the year, following November

ex.en: My cousin is coming to stay with us in December.
ex.zh: 我表亲十二月要来我们家住。

ex.en: In many northern countries, energy demand increases in December as households need more heating during colder weather.
ex.zh: 在许多北方国家，十二月天气更冷，家庭需要更多供暖，因此能源需求增加。

tip: 月份首字母大写；在十二月用in December。

senses.en: Not many; a small number of countable things.
A small number of people or things.

ex.en: There were few customers in the shop this morning.
ex.zh: 今天上午店里的顾客很少。

ex.en: Few rural communities have access to the specialist medical services available in major cities.
ex.zh: 很少有农村社区能获得大城市所提供的专科医疗服务。

col: few and far between｜少之又少
tip: few表几乎没有，a few表有几个；均接可数名词复数。

senses.en: an object whose name is unknown or not specified
an action, event, fact, or situation
possessions or equipment, usually referred to in the plural

ex.en: Could you move that heavy thing off my chair?
ex.zh: 你能把那个沉东西从我的椅子上搬走吗？

ex.en: One important thing governments can do is ensure that affordable housing is available near public transport.
ex.zh: 政府可以做的一件重要事情，是确保公共交通附近有可负担的住房。

col: the right thing to do｜正确的做法
first thing in the morning｜早晨第一件事
one thing at a time｜一次一件事
tip: thing很笼统；正式写作尽量换成具体名词。

senses.en: come together with someone, by arrangement or chance
fulfil a need or reach a required standard

ex.en: Let's meet outside the library after lunch today.
ex.zh: 我们今天午饭后在图书馆外见吧。

ex.en: Public transport services must meet the needs of residents who cannot afford private cars.
ex.zh: 公共交通服务必须满足那些买不起私家车的居民的需求。

col: meet someone for the first time｜初次见到某人
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为met；meet要求时意为满足。

senses.en: A Christian festival celebrating Jesus Christ's return to life.

ex.en: We decorated eggs together at the kitchen table for Easter.
ex.zh: 我们一起坐在厨房桌旁，为复活节装饰彩蛋。

ex.en: During Easter, many destinations attract additional visitors through seasonal events, creating temporary employment in the tourism sector.
ex.zh: 复活节期间，许多旅游目的地通过节庆活动吸引更多游客，为旅游业创造临时就业机会。

tip: 节日名首字母大写；at Easter指复活节期间。
note: 已将节日名称的首字母改为大写。

senses.en: a journey to a place and usually back again
to stumble or make someone stumble by catching a foot

ex.en: Our weekend trip to the coast was wonderfully relaxing.
ex.zh: 我们周末的海滨之旅让人十分放松。

ex.en: School trips to museums can enrich classroom learning by giving students direct access to historical objects.
ex.zh: 学校组织的博物馆参观能让学生直接接触历史实物，从而丰富课堂学习。

tip: trip 是可数名词；travel 表示旅行活动时通常不可数。

senses.en: A period of twelve months
An annual period organised for education, business, or another purpose

ex.en: We moved into this flat almost a year ago.
ex.zh: 我们搬进这套公寓快一年了。

ex.en: A gap year can give students valuable work experience before they begin university studies.
ex.zh: 间隔年可以让学生在开始大学学习前获得宝贵的工作经验。

tip: last year等时间短语前不加介词；年龄用years old。

senses.en: an event or struggle in which people compete to win
to formally challenge a decision, claim, or result
to compete for a position, prize, or political seat

ex.en: My cousin won a baking contest with her lemon cake.
ex.zh: 我表姐凭她做的柠檬蛋糕赢得了烘焙比赛。

ex.en: Citizens should have access to affordable legal advice when they wish to contest an official decision.
ex.zh: 公民希望对官方决定提出异议时，应能获得价格合理的法律咨询。

col: a close contest｜势均力敌的比赛
contest a decision｜对决定提出异议
tip: 名词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: relating to a whole country or its people
a person who is a citizen of a particular country

ex.en: My sister hopes to join the national swimming team.
ex.zh: 我姐姐希望加入国家游泳队。

ex.en: National policies can help reduce regional differences in access to healthcare and education.
ex.zh: 国家政策有助于缩小医疗和教育机会方面的地区差异。

tip: national侧重一国整体；international指国际的。

senses.en: relating to the United States, its people, or its culture
a person from the United States

ex.en: My American neighbour invited us over for pumpkin pie.
ex.zh: 我的美国邻居邀请我们去他家吃南瓜派。

ex.en: American universities attract international students through their diverse courses, research facilities, and opportunities for professional development.
ex.zh: 美国大学凭借多样的课程、科研设施和职业发展机会吸引国际学生。

tip: 首字母始终大写；通常指美国，而非整个美洲。

senses.en: The expression of gratitude, especially in prayer.
A holiday for expressing gratitude, celebrated in the US and Canada.

ex.en: They held a small thanksgiving ceremony after the harvest.
ex.zh: 收获后，他们举行了一场小型感恩仪式。

ex.en: In some countries, Thanksgiving brings families together and encourages reflection on the importance of community support.
ex.zh: 在一些国家，感恩节让家人团聚，也促使人们思考社区互助的重要性。

col: a prayer of thanksgiving｜感恩祷告
tip: 指节日时首字母大写；泛指感恩时用小写。

senses.en: the Christian festival celebrating Jesus's birth, or the surrounding period

ex.en: Our family usually shares a special meal at Christmas.
ex.zh: 我们一家通常在圣诞节一起享用一顿特别的饭菜。

ex.en: During Christmas, increased consumer spending can benefit local shops, although it may also generate additional packaging waste.
ex.zh: 圣诞节期间，消费支出的增加可以使当地商店受益，但也可能产生更多包装废弃物。

tip: 首字母大写；节日期间用at，当天用on Christmas Day。

senses.en: A period away from work or study for rest or travel.
An officially recognised day when many people do not work.
To spend time away from home for pleasure.

ex.en: We spent our holiday swimming and exploring quiet villages.
ex.zh: 我们假期里游泳，还探访了宁静的村庄。

ex.en: Flexible holiday arrangements can improve employee wellbeing while allowing businesses to maintain essential services throughout the year.
ex.zh: 灵活的休假安排可以改善员工福祉，同时让企业全年维持基本服务。

tip: 英式on holiday指度假；美式通常说on vacation。

senses.en: an activity or contest played according to rules
wild animals hunted for food or sport, or their meat
willing to try something difficult or unfamiliar

ex.en: We played a board game after dinner yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天晚饭后我们玩了一个桌游。

ex.en: Cooperative games can help children develop communication skills and learn to solve problems together.
ex.zh: 合作型游戏能帮助儿童培养沟通能力，并学会共同解决问题。

tip: 猎物义不可数；be game for表示愿意尝试。

senses.en: To move or make something move by turning over repeatedly
To form something into a curved or cylindrical shape
Material wound around itself, or a small individual bread

ex.en: The orange rolled off the table and under my chair.
ex.zh: 橙子从桌上滚下来，滚到了我的椅子底下。

ex.en: Workers roll sheets of recycled material into compact bundles to simplify storage and transportation.
ex.zh: 工人把再生材料薄片卷成紧实的捆，以便储存和运输。

col: roll down a hill｜滚下山坡
roll up your sleeves｜卷起袖子
tip: roll强调翻转滚动；卷起常用roll up。

senses.en: A sweet food made from cocoa, often with milk and sugar.
An individual sweet made of chocolate, sometimes with a filling.

ex.en: He shared a bar of chocolate with his sister.
ex.zh: 他和妹妹分享了一块巧克力。

ex.en: Consumers increasingly expect chocolate producers to ensure fair wages and safe working conditions throughout their supply chains.
ex.zh: 消费者越来越期望巧克力生产商确保整个供应链中的公平工资和安全工作条件。

col: a bar of chocolate｜一块巧克力
a box of chocolates｜一盒巧克力糖
tip: 食材巧克力不可数；单颗巧克力糖可数。

senses.zh: 请回复 Répondez s'il vous plaît.

senses.en: Shows who or what performs an action in passive sentences.
Using a particular method or means.
No later than a particular time.

ex.en: This wooden bowl was made by my grandfather.
ex.zh: 这个木碗是我祖父做的。

ex.en: Urban air quality can be improved by expanding public transport and encouraging residents to cycle more often.
ex.zh: 扩大公共交通服务并鼓励居民更多骑车，可以改善城市空气质量。

col: by the end of｜不迟于……结束时
tip: by表示截止时间；until表示状态持续到某时。

senses.en: coming before all others in order or time
before anything or anyone else

ex.en: This is my first visit to the seaside.
ex.zh: 这是我第一次到海边来。

ex.en: Governments should first improve public transport before encouraging residents to give up private cars.
ex.zh: 政府应先改善公共交通，再鼓励居民放弃私家车。

tip: at first指起初；first可用于列举第一点。

senses.en: Coming immediately after the first in an order.
A unit of time equal to one sixtieth of a minute.
To formally support a proposal made by someone else.

ex.en: This is my second cup of tea today.
ex.zh: 这是我今天喝的第二杯茶。

ex.en: Learning a second language can broaden career opportunities and help students understand perspectives from other cultures.
ex.zh: 学习第二语言可以拓宽职业机会，并帮助学生理解其他文化的观点。

tip: the second指第二个；a second可指又一个。

senses.en: Coming after the second and before the fourth.
One of three equal parts of something.

ex.en: Our flat is on the third floor, beside the lift.
ex.zh: 我们的公寓在三楼，电梯旁边。

ex.en: Approximately one third of the city's residents rely on public transport for their daily commute.
ex.zh: 该市约三分之一的居民依靠公共交通进行日常通勤。

tip: 表示分数：one third；two thirds。

senses.en: coming immediately after the third in a sequence
one of four equal parts of a whole

ex.en: Our apartment is on the fourth floor, beside the lift.
ex.zh: 我们的公寓在四楼，就在电梯旁边。

ex.en: The fourth stage of the recycling process involves transforming cleaned plastic into material suitable for new products.
ex.zh: 回收流程的第四阶段是将清洗后的塑料转化为适合制造新产品的材料。

tip: 第四是fourth；forth意为向前，注意拼写。

senses.en: coming after four other things in a series
one of five equal parts of something

col: in the fifth century｜在五世纪
her fifth birthday｜她的五岁生日

senses.en: Coming after the eleventh in a sequence.
One of twelve equal parts of something.

ex.en: We celebrated her twelfth birthday with a homemade cake.
ex.zh: 我们用自制蛋糕庆祝了她的十二岁生日。

ex.en: By the twelfth month of the programme, most participants had developed more effective study habits.
ex.zh: 到该项目的第十二个月时，大多数参与者已经养成了更有效的学习习惯。

col: one twelfth of｜……的十二分之一
tip: twelve变序数词为twelfth，注意ve变为f。

senses.zh: 第二十的；二十分之一的

ex.en: One twentieth of the total output was exported.
ex.zh: 产量中有二十分之一出口。

senses.en: Different from usual, often in an important or valued way.
Intended for a particular purpose or person.
A specially priced product or a featured restaurant dish.

ex.en: We saved this special cake for your birthday.
ex.zh: 我们把这个特别的蛋糕留到了你生日时享用。

ex.en: Schools should provide special equipment so that students with disabilities can participate fully in classroom activities.
ex.zh: 学校应提供专用设备，让残障学生能够充分参与课堂活动。

tip: specially强调专门；especially常表示尤其。

senses.en: someone who behaves without good sense or judgment
to make someone believe something that is not true

ex.en: The realistic plastic spider fooled everyone at the party.
ex.zh: 那只逼真的塑料蜘蛛骗过了聚会上的所有人。

ex.en: Misleading advertisements can fool consumers into buying products that offer little practical benefit.
ex.zh: 误导性广告可能诱使消费者购买几乎没有实际用处的产品。

col: fool someone into doing something｜骗某人做某事
make a fool of yourself｜出洋相
tip: fool作名词称呼别人有贬义；动词可接into doing。

senses.en: A book containing personal accounts of daily events and feelings.
A book used to record appointments and future plans.

ex.en: I write in my diary before going to bed.
ex.zh: 我睡前会写日记。

ex.en: Keeping a learning diary encourages students to reflect on their progress and identify difficulties.
ex.zh: 坚持写学习日记能鼓励学生反思自己的进步并发现困难。

tip: diary是日记，dairy是乳制品；注意字母顺序。

senses.en: Continuing up to a particular time without stopping or changing.
Not moving.
Despite what has just been said.

ex.en: It is nearly midnight, but my sister is still awake.
ex.zh: 快到午夜了，可我姐姐还醒着。

ex.en: Despite improvements in public transport, many commuters still rely on private cars because services remain unreliable in rural areas.
ex.zh: 尽管公共交通有所改善，许多通勤者仍依赖私家车，因为农村地区的公共交通服务依然不可靠。

tip: 表“仍然”时，通常放实义动词前、be动词后。

senses.en: a sound, especially one that is loud or unwanted

ex.en: The noise outside woke me before my alarm rang.
ex.zh: 外面的噪音在闹钟响之前就把我吵醒了。

ex.en: Prolonged exposure to traffic noise can affect sleep quality and reduce the wellbeing of urban residents.
ex.zh: 长期接触交通噪音会影响睡眠质量，降低城市居民的身心健康水平。

tip: 泛指噪音时不可数；指某个具体声响可用a noise。

senses.en: the thick soft hair covering some animals
animal skin with hair attached, used for making clothing

ex.en: The cat's wet fur dried quickly in the sunshine.
ex.zh: 猫湿漉漉的毛在阳光下很快就干了。

ex.en: Thick fur helps many mammals survive in cold climates by trapping a layer of warm air.
ex.zh: 浓密的毛通过留住一层暖空气，帮助许多哺乳动物在寒冷气候中生存。

tip: 指动物身上的毛通常不可数；羽毛用feather。

senses.en: Not closed, or available for people to enter and use.
To make something accessible or start operating a business.
Honest about your thoughts, or willing to consider new ideas.

ex.en: Leave the window open so fresh air can come in.
ex.zh: 让窗户开着，好让新鲜空气进来。

ex.en: Governments should remain open to public feedback when developing policies that affect access to essential services.
ex.zh: 政府制定影响基本服务获取的政策时，应保持开放态度，听取公众反馈。

col: open to the public｜向公众开放
open to suggestions｜愿意听取建议
keep an open mind｜保持开放心态
tip: be open表示开着的状态；open作动词表示打开的动作。

senses.en: To move on foot at a pace slower than running
A journey made on foot, often for pleasure

ex.en: We walk to the bakery every Sunday morning.
ex.zh: 我们每个星期天早上都步行去面包店。

ex.en: Safe pavements and attractive public spaces encourage residents to walk rather than drive for short journeys.
ex.zh: 安全的人行道和宜人的公共空间能鼓励居民短途出行时步行而不开车。

tip: 字母l不发音；walk the dog意为遛狗。

senses.en: used to refer to something that belongs to or is connected with a woman, girl, or female animal that has already been mentioned

ex.en: He bent and touched his mouth to hers.
ex.zh: 他俯身吻她的嘴唇。

ex.en: These are my gloves. Hers are in the drawer.
ex.zh: 这是我的手套，她的在抽屉里。

senses.en: The one or ones belonging to them

ex.en: Our garden is small, but theirs has several trees.
ex.zh: 我们的花园很小，但他们的花园里有好几棵树。

ex.en: Some families own their homes, while others rent theirs because property prices remain beyond their reach.
ex.zh: 有些家庭拥有自己的住房，另一些则因房价仍超出承受能力而租房居住。

col: a friend of theirs｜他们的一位朋友
ours and theirs｜我们的和他们的
tip: theirs独立使用，后不接名词，也不加撇号。

senses.en: used to refer to something that belongs to or is connected with us

ex.en: I’ll show you to your room. Ours is next door.
ex.zh: 我带你去你的房间，我们的房间在你的隔壁。

ex.en: The main difference between our brains and those of monkeys is that ours are bigger.
ex.zh: 我们的大脑和猴子的大脑之间的主要差别在于我们的要大些。

senses.en: The sport of going up rocks, mountains, or artificial walls.
Growing upwards by attaching to or winding around supports.

ex.en: I tried indoor climbing with my sister yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我和姐姐尝试了室内攀岩。

ex.en: Schools can use supervised climbing activities to develop students' confidence, physical coordination, and ability to assess risks.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过有人指导的攀岩活动，培养学生的自信、身体协调性和风险评估能力。

tip: climb中的b不发音；climbing plants指攀缘植物。

senses.en: the activity of taking food into your body
taking food into your mouth and swallowing it

ex.en: Healthy eating starts with small changes to your meals.
ex.zh: 健康饮食始于对日常餐食的小调整。

ex.en: Schools can encourage healthy eating by providing balanced lunches and teaching children how to prepare simple meals.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过提供营养均衡的午餐并教孩子制作简单餐食来鼓励健康饮食。

tip: eating可作动名词；eat out表示外出就餐。

senses.en: Every individual member of a group, considered separately.
Every person or thing in a group, taken separately.
For every individual person or thing.

ex.en: Each child carried a small basket into the garden.
ex.zh: 每个孩子都提着一个小篮子走进花园。

ex.en: Each household can reduce its environmental impact by conserving water and choosing products with less packaging.
ex.zh: 每个家庭都可以通过节约用水和选择包装较少的产品来减少对环境的影响。

tip: each后接单数名词；each of后接复数名词或代词。

senses.en: Different from or additional to those already mentioned.
A remaining or different person or thing.

ex.en: This shoe fits, but where is the other one?
ex.zh: 这只鞋合脚，但另一只在哪里？

ex.en: Schools should teach practical skills alongside other subjects to prepare students for the demands of adult life.
ex.zh: 学校应在教授其他科目的同时传授实用技能，让学生为成年生活的要求做好准备。

col: on the other hand｜另一方面
tip: other后接名词；others独立使用；两者中另一个用the other。

senses.en: Feeling very happy and enthusiastic about something.

ex.en: The children were excited about their first camping trip.
ex.zh: 孩子们对第一次露营旅行感到兴奋。

ex.en: Students are often more excited about learning when lessons involve practical experiments and opportunities for discovery.
ex.zh: 当课程包含实践实验和探索机会时，学生往往对学习更有热情。

tip: 人感到兴奋用excited；事物令人兴奋用exciting。

senses.en: to enjoy something or feel positively about someone
similar to someone or something
used to introduce an example

ex.en: I like reading by the window on rainy afternoons.
ex.zh: 我喜欢在下雨的午后坐在窗边读书。

ex.en: Many residents like having green spaces nearby because they provide opportunities for exercise and relaxation.
ex.zh: 许多居民喜欢附近有绿地，因为绿地提供了锻炼和放松的机会。

col: feel like doing something｜想做某事
tip: would like to do 比 want to do 更礼貌。

senses.en: To continue having something rather than giving it away.
To stay, or make something stay, in a particular state.
To continue doing something or do it repeatedly.

ex.en: You can keep the umbrella until the rain stops.
ex.zh: 雨停之前，你可以继续留着这把伞用。

ex.en: Governments should keep public transport affordable to encourage residents to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 政府应使公共交通保持价格实惠，鼓励居民不开私家车出行。

tip: 过去式、过去分词均为kept；继续做用keep doing。

senses.en: Move around a centre or change direction.
Change to a different state, colour, or condition.
An opportunity to do something in an agreed order.

ex.en: Turn the handle gently and pull the door towards you.
ex.zh: 轻轻转动把手，然后朝自己这边拉门。

ex.en: As populations age, governments must turn their attention to accessible housing and community healthcare.
ex.zh: 随着人口老龄化，政府必须将注意力转向无障碍住房和社区医疗。

tip: 表示变得时，turn后接形容词；turn into后接名词。

senses.en: A tall plant with hollow woody stems, or its strong material.

ex.en: She planted bamboo along the fence for extra privacy.
ex.zh: 她沿着围栏种了竹子，让院子更私密。

ex.en: Bamboo grows rapidly and can provide a renewable building material when plantations are managed responsibly.
ex.zh: 竹子生长迅速，在种植园得到负责任管理的情况下，可以提供可再生建筑材料。

tip: 泛指竹子或竹材时通常不可数。

ex.en: He emphasized its importance to me.
ex.zh: 他向我强调它的重要性。

ex.en: The child read the story but did not comprehend its meaning.
ex.zh: 这个孩子读了这篇故事，但不能理解它的意思。

senses.en: To let someone see something or demonstrate how something works.
To provide information or evidence that something is true.
A performance, programme, or public display intended for an audience.

ex.en: Please show me how to fold this paper bird.
ex.zh: 请教我怎么折这只纸鸟。

ex.en: Recent studies show that access to green spaces can improve mental wellbeing in urban populations.
ex.zh: 近期研究表明，能够使用绿地有助于改善城市居民的心理健康。

col: show someone how to｜教某人如何
tip: 过去式showed，过去分词通常用shown。

senses.en: Any thing at all, without limits on choice
Something, used especially in questions and conditional statements

ex.en: You can choose anything from this basket of toys.
ex.zh: 你可以从这篮玩具里随便挑一件。

ex.en: Before introducing new policies, governments should check whether anything similar has worked successfully elsewhere.
ex.zh: 在推行新政策之前，政府应查明其他地方是否有类似的成功做法。

tip: 疑问句中常指“什么”；陈述句中可指“任何事物”。

senses.en: In addition to or different from someone or something mentioned
Used after or to introduce an alternative or consequence

ex.en: Would you like anything else with your soup?
ex.zh: 除了汤，你还想要点别的吗？

ex.en: Governments must improve public transport, or else growing traffic congestion may undermine the economic benefits of urban development.
ex.zh: 政府必须改善公共交通，否则日益严重的交通拥堵可能削弱城市发展带来的经济效益。

tip: 放在不定代词或疑问词后，如someone else。

senses.en: A public display of art, objects, or products.

ex.en: We visited a photography exhibition at the local museum.
ex.zh: 我们参观了当地博物馆的一场摄影展。

ex.en: An interactive exhibition can make scientific discoveries more accessible to children and encourage their interest in research.
ex.zh: 互动展览能让儿童更容易理解科学发现，并激发他们对研究的兴趣。

tip: exhibition指整场展览；exhibit可指一件展品。

senses.en: To express something using words.
To give information in writing or through other evidence.
The opportunity to influence a decision.

ex.en: Please say your name again so I can remember it.
ex.zh: 请再说一遍你的名字，好让我记住。

ex.en: Residents should have a say in planning decisions that directly affect their neighbourhoods and daily lives.
ex.zh: 居民应当对直接影响其社区和日常生活的规划决策拥有发言权。

col: say something to someone｜对某人说某事
have a say in｜对……有发言权
tip: 说某事用say something；告诉某人用tell someone。

senses.en: Help someone learn knowledge, skills, or ways of behaving

ex.en: My aunt taught me how to mend a shirt.
ex.zh: 姑姑教会了我如何缝补衬衫。

ex.en: Schools should teach children how to evaluate online information rather than simply memorise facts.
ex.zh: 学校应教孩子如何评估网上的信息，而非只是死记事实。

col: teach a subject｜教授一门学科
teach someone to swim｜教某人游泳
teach a lesson｜授课；给以教训
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为taught；教某人做用teach sb to do。

senses.en: Feeling no doubt that something is true or correct.
Certain to happen or do something.
Used informally to agree or strongly confirm something.

ex.en: Are you sure you left your keys here?
ex.zh: 你确定把钥匙落在这里了吗？

ex.en: Governments must make sure that rural communities have reliable access to essential healthcare services.
ex.zh: 政府必须确保农村社区能够稳定地获得基本医疗服务。

tip: be sure of表确信；be sure to可表必然或叮嘱。

senses.en: relating to Canada, its people, or its culture
a person from Canada

ex.en: Our Canadian neighbour invited us over for dinner yesterday.
ex.zh: 我们的加拿大邻居昨天邀请我们去他家吃晚饭。

ex.en: Canadian cities face challenges in providing affordable housing while accommodating population growth and protecting green spaces.
ex.zh: 加拿大城市面临着提供可负担住房、容纳增长人口以及保护绿地的多重挑战。

tip: 国籍词首字母大写；名词复数为Canadians。

senses.en: the language spoken in Spain and many Latin American countries
relating to Spain, its people, culture, or language

ex.en: I practise Spanish with my neighbour after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后我和邻居一起练习西班牙语。

ex.en: Learning Spanish can broaden students' access to literature and improve their opportunities for international employment.
ex.zh: 学习西班牙语能拓宽学生接触文学作品的渠道，并增加他们在国际就业市场上的机会。

tip: 首字母大写；一个西班牙人可说a Spanish person。

senses.en: Study of the natural world through observation and experiments
A particular field of study using scientific methods

ex.en: We grew tiny crystals in our science class today.
ex.zh: 今天的科学课上，我们培育了微小的晶体。

ex.en: Investment in science can help countries develop cleaner energy sources and improve public health.
ex.zh: 科学投入能帮助各国开发更清洁的能源，并改善公共健康。

tip: 泛指科学通常不可数；指具体学科可用a science。

senses.en: a building displaying objects of historical, scientific, or artistic interest

ex.en: We saw a huge dinosaur skeleton at the museum.
ex.zh: 我们在博物馆看到了一具巨大的恐龙骨架。

ex.en: Museums can help young people understand local history by connecting everyday objects with the lives of previous generations.
ex.zh: 博物馆可以将日常物品与前人的生活联系起来，帮助年轻人了解当地历史。

col: natural history museum｜自然历史博物馆
tip: museum是可数名词；参观博物馆说visit a museum。

senses.en: a place where people send mail and buy stamps

ex.en: I took the parcel to the post office before lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭前，我把包裹送到了邮局。

ex.en: A local post office can provide essential services for rural residents who lack reliable internet access.
ex.zh: 当地邮局可以为缺乏可靠网络连接的农村居民提供基本服务。

tip: 标准拼写为post office，两词之间不加连字符。
note: 已将非标准连字符拼写改为post office

senses.en: a store that sells books

ex.en: The bookstore near my flat stays open until nine.
ex.zh: 我公寓附近的书店一直营业到九点。

ex.en: Although online shopping offers convenience, a physical bookstore allows customers to browse and receive personal recommendations.
ex.zh: 虽然网购很方便，但实体书店能让顾客翻阅书籍并获得个性化推荐。

tip: bookstore是美式常用词，不是借书的library。

senses.en: A place where people pay to watch films.
Films considered as an art form or industry.

ex.en: We met outside the cinema and bought some popcorn.
ex.zh: 我们在电影院外碰面，买了些爆米花。

ex.en: International cinema allows audiences to explore unfamiliar cultures and consider social issues from different perspectives.
ex.zh: 国际电影让观众能够了解陌生的文化，并从不同角度思考社会问题。

col: go to the cinema｜去看电影
tip: 英式常说go to the cinema，美式常说go to the movies。
